name: AMARI
description: Verify any AI-drafted legal document. AMARI identifies errors in citations, defined terms, cross-references, and statutory compliance, then returns a corrected document with legal reasoning and a cryptographic audit trail. Covers 8 practice areas including IP, Corporate & Commercial, Litigation, Employment, Privacy, Regulatory, AI Governance, and Product Law.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AMARI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AMARI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.getamari.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AMARI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AMARI provides these MCP tools: amari_verify and amari_status.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AMARI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AMARI in business-productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Pyth, Domhaul, Idiolect AI, aster-share, and aquent-jobs.
AMARI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AMARI is developed by Wisdom Agent Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
